key_insight: CGTransformer improves autoregressive crystal generation by ordering atoms using crystal topology rather than coordinates.
engineering_relevance: Topology-guided sequences improve structure recovery at fixed model capacity and support property-targeted design of wide-bandgap semiconductors.
method: Represent periodic crystal connectivity with quotient graphs.
Use Element Symmetry Graph (ESG) sorting and barycentric embeddings to construct topology-guided sequences.
Train an autoregressive transformer for crystal generation and property-conditioned inverse design.
evidence_signal: On MP-20, CGTransformer achieves a 63.24% single-shot crystal structure prediction match rate—the highest among compared baselines—and ESG improves structure recovery and stable, unique, novel generation over coordinate-based ordering.
watch_item: Performance beyond the reported benchmark and semiconductor targets remains to be established; implementation also requires reliable graph construction and barycentric embedding.
paper_title: CGTransformer: A Topology-Aware Autoregressive Framework for Crystal Generation and Inverse Design
